description: What the main window's interface reaches for: the core defaults, the listener it follows the library, a held close and the window's maximized state on, the folder picker, showing a file in its folder, and opening a web page in the user's own browser. Plus two reaches that are not calls of the interface's: `core:window:allow-start-dragging`, which is what Tauri's own injected script asks for when the pointer goes down on the titlebar, whose element carries `data-tauri-drag-region`; and `snap-layout:default`, which is what `tauri-plugin-snap-layout`'s injected script asks for to keep the maximize button's hit test where the button is. The window's own buttons go through commands of the application's (see `src-tauri/src/commands/window.rs`) and need nothing from here; `core:window:default` already carries the double click's `internal-toggle-maximize`, and the rest of that set is getters
